tools.name: list_languages
tools.description: The 60 languages Ordkort teaches and explains in, with their codes.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: The built-in topics for word lists (greetings, food, the doctor, documents and public services…), with their ids.

tools.name: ready_words
tools.description: Words already in Ordkort's shared bank for a topic and level, with translations, forms and examples. Nouns and verbs have been checked against dictionaries. May be empty for a rare pair of languages; then write the words yourself.

tools.name: find_pictures
tools.description: Openly licensed pictures for a word: first the Wikimedia Commons picture of the Wikidata item the word names (found in the word's own language, so "hus" in nb finds a house), then Pixabay's photos and drawings, then Openverse's, sorted so those whose title or tags hold the word come first. tools.name: design_guide
tools.description: How a card is built, the fields and pictures a template can use, and the CSS variables and parts of the site. Read it before create_design.

tools.name: create_deck
tools.description: Makes a deck of up to 500 cards and returns a link. When the person opens the link, Ordkort shows the deck and adds it to their cards if they agree. tools.description: Makes a look for Ordkort and returns a link that shows it and applies it if the person agrees. Read design_guide first. front_html and back_html are card templates with fields in double braces: {{term}}, {{translation}}, {{pronunciation}}, {{grammar}}, {{forms}}, {{example}}, {{example_translation}}
